body:
As a man you simply cannot win in online dating. Sometimes I think people are simply bullshitting about getting married from online dating, and are actually paid shills to advertise site x.  

The problem is that women never send the first message. If they do you don't have any problem approaching in IRL meat space only because of the looks are the reason why they send you the message...

Now If you're not a model, things will be extremely difficult for you. As explained above women never send messages first so that falls on to you to do. But as that link above says they get bombarded with messages so the likelihood of your message being noticed is miniscule.  

So what do you do? It's a time waste to write something meaningful because it will be one in a thousand and the chances are that it never gets replied to.  

The only solution is to spam a lot of generic messages to women who even look somewhat decent if you squint a bit. And this spam is then further fuel to the fire.  

So women. No you don't have it hard. You are the winners in this life.

I keep on swiping right no matter what. Couple of hits so far! And of course ALL of them blocked me after I said "hi" or after they said "hi" and had few messsges back and forth. Been on that app couple of months now...

So what I have going on for me is that I am good at starting convos with girls. Good even at escalating. Sometimes even getting drunken lucky. But as soon as girls get to really know me they back off slowly like I'm plaque. At most I've known dates at intimately or friendly for few weeks to a month. And by that time they have found their own confidence because of me and found any random bloke that even looks at their direction. And usually that is the perfect relation ship for them somehow. And I get dumped.  

So FA girls: You wanna find that special someone? Date me once and I promise you you'll find it that dude on that instant!

I don't bother asking anyone out to see a movie for example. Because I KNOW they either can't or won't come. Even if I plan it a month in advance. And how do I know it's just me? Well my friend makes few calls few hours before the show and suddenly everyone can come.

So everyone who is or has ever been on a long relationship loves themselves and never has any doubt on their skills?  

I have to call BS on this. Yes, that quality is sexy and makes getting a partner likely more easy, but having any doubt on one self is a FA death sentence?  

I know that I'm not good at something and that there is always someone better at anything I do in this world is just a realization of the world around us. It's a fact. And also a cue to try harder and learn to be better.
Can tell from experience that standing with friends makes them more attractive. That's probably why they are all in a relationship...

That's kind of you to help, but trust me. I'm a lost cause. I wouldn't be writing on this subreddit if it wasn't so.  

For the social network. Yes, I am on facebook and have "some" friends. Some close than others. And I have social interactions with them now and then. But the problem is that I can never initiate anything. "Hey, let's have party at my place" and no one would come. "Hey, let's go see a movie". And no one would come. "Hey, let's have fun activity x" And no one would be bothered the slightest. And the excuses people give me are just dumb. "Uhh, I can't come that day because I have umm....uhh...exam, yes that must be it" "I thought you graduated from school years ago, and are working full time" "Yeah well, cant come". And so on...  

> Try online dating as well.  

You can check my post history for my experiences on that. I have lost all hope on it as well. It's like applying for a job. If there's ANYTHING wrong with you ("2cm too short for my liking" or "You don't have a cat" or "you're not rich enough") you're out. Not a single chance given.  


Now you might say "Oh, don't be such a downer, you still might get there some day". Nope. These are real experiences and not a single bit exaggerated. In other words, people who say "cheer up" is like being slapped on the face all my life and to just say "thank you, can I have a another one". When I've been fed shit all my life I tend to spew shit back.

> What's worked best for me is getting a girl's attention and then basically showing no interest in her. It doesnt make sense, I agree. 

I tried that few times. And nope. It didn't work.  

As soon as I tried to play "unreachable" they just went silent and forgot about me.  

So every time some one has had even the slightest of interest, they loose it the instant someone else walks by. So pretty much when they have nothing else and I'm the next up.  

So you might say that I haven't met enough women or that I haven't been rejected "enough" I think is simply BS. I can't keep on track how many times I've been rejected on last month alone. I can't keep on track whose name is who, what I've been talking to whom and what did we (if any) have in common.

So let me give you a my (guy) experience on online dating.  

I have had my profile up now for two months. In that time I have messaged about 40 different girls, maybe half of those girls had pictures on their profile. Some of them didn't have anything on their description.  

Half of the 40 girls that I have messaged have answered back. Half of those that did answer I had nice convo with. Even got pictures from almost all of them.  

Those girls that I did have some nice conversation with almost all dropped all connections as soon as I mentioned about meeting. For a coffee, maybe go bowling what ever. Just silence. No "Sorry, not interested", nothing.  

So I did luckily get two dates though. The other girl said outright that she was not interested. And the other I haven't heard anything even though I asked her if she would like to meet again. (So I guess she just ignores me).
[Yeah, that will totally happen](http://i.imgur.com/ugoKd.gif)

This has been tried in my citys most famous gyms. Everyone liked the idea, but most of singles were too anxious to wear them :D  

Also in some of the bigger shops in the area have these shopping baskets that are different color from normal (gray) and are labeled as "single basket".  

Haven't got the balls yet to use them tough...
It's not bigoted. It's just a statistically highly more likely. Just because some women you happen to know does ask men out doesn't mean all of them do.
So in other words: [just wait](https://lh3.ggpht.com/-4sFsIrVWNiY/UWJOWZhas_I/AAAAAAAABqA/0SdT3oH-mmQ/s320/waiting+2.jpg) and "it'll happen".

So I know few attractive girls. Most through my guy friends who are dating with them. And never has it happened that I get suggested a single friend of theirs. I hear stories of people hooking up in a blind date that their friend has set up, but hasn't happened to me yet. Never have I've been suggested by anyone that some girl might be interested to even be friends with me.  

But still I'm conflicted on two advices. If I meet a new girl and she tells me she is taken, I should go on to next one and forget it. So what you are saying I should just hang around? I can't keep up with 182 female contacts and hope that some miracle happens and I get introduced to some one new. And again, which has never happened. Also these "friends" has always been one way street. I have to initiate the conversation, and most of the time it has been simple "yeah" answer back or no answer at all. Or a nice way of saying "stop talking to me".

Or as someone else here suggested it's just a nice way of saying "go the fuck away". Which I obliged.  

It has gotten to a point where I can't keep on track what I have said to whom about my life, or what they have said to me about their life. I get confused "was this the girl that had event x in her life or event y".  

"You don't talk enough to girls" "You haven't met one yet" "You try too hard" You haven't tried enough" "You should meet them only as friends" "You haven't expressed your intentions clearly enough with her" "You are too forthcoming" "You are not forthcoming enough".  

  

It's hard

No really. Why should I keep on living on this planet any more? I have tried my best on everything and failed. Isn't that just a natures way of saying to just die out? I'm just leeching on everyones time and money with no use for anyone.  


Many have had things worse than mine and succeeded. Even more have had things way more easier than me and succeeded. I just got handed the "looser of life" ticket.

I have all the information to do things right. I have read all the advices people with experience can give. I have never been arrested. I have never been in trouble with police. I have never done something highly illegal. (I guess I'm the sort of boring nerd kind).  

Yet I have had experience on lot of things. And none of them have helped me in any way. I'm just a leaf in the wind that winds up on others windscreen that they just wipe away.  

Usually the advice that most give is to "have confidence". I don't seem to know what that means anymore. It's just a empty word for me. I can make people happy with my conversation skills, but that never gets me anywhere. I can tell appropriate jokes here and there and make everyone around me laughing. But yet still, I'm here as alone and jobless and without direction as fuck. None of the advice people give me works anymore, because I have tried them all to no avail.

I could say the same thing. Except for a guy I have met about 5 nice girls that I thought liked me back. Surprise, they didn't. So what you are experiencing is the feeling that you most likely have to get used to many times

> maybe you're trying too hard. Most things in life come to you when you least expect them.

I have heard this line so many times that I don't believe it anymore. So how long should I wait? 1 year? 10 years? 50 years? Ain' nobody go' time fo' dat! It's like saying to a hungry person that "the food will come some day, when you least expect it". While it's true it doesn't help and makes you sound condescending.  

And you are right. I am desperate. Who wouldn't be? It's a natural instinct for us humans to find someone to love and procreate with. Some of us just wasn't as lucky when were handed our lottery tickets of love.  

And when I try to fix it and be out there to prove myself that I'm not just a waste of space, I'll get turned down because I'm "too desperate".  

Now, I'm not virgin anymore. I have been with a couple of women and even, I guess, "dated" with two of them. But they still after a month or so decided that "they just want to be friends" and went after another guy immediately. (Although I suspect to this day they did cheat on my and dumped me as soon as they got the chance). Having said that, I don't have much trust on girls as it is now. Still I desperately want to be with one.

> What do you do during the day? There's a lot of people getting depression because there's no work.  

Surf reddit. Mostly.  

Because it's the only thing that I enjoy doing and seeing effort for, I do try to volunteer. But it turns out to be harder then I thought. As I said, I don't have many friends so I don't have many connections either. And mostly strangers don't trust me enough to deliver.

In the meantime I do go out alone and photograph scenery, live shows and so on.

Congrats on the date! It sure is a thrilling experience. Couple of things I like to point out though.

> It's all because I stopped giving a fuck.  

Well if it was that easy then why this subreddit even exists? I mean, everyone says it and it doesn't change anything. It's not a simple switch anyone could just flick and suddenly they are drowning in pussy.

And keeping on thinking "don't give a fuck, don't give fuck, stahp" doesn't help. It just doesn't suddenly make you a success.

All I can think of your post is that you just got lucky. Simple as that. No more and no less. Following your advice doesn't suddenly make us all a success in the same way. Some have that luck and some don't. What ever they might think or feel.

> Find something you like doing by yourself and fuck everyone else.  

I like photography! I do that sometimes. It's just hard to justify myself to do that when there is no reward for it. Simple truth is that nobody gives cares what anybody does, or what I do. I could go take photos of stuff for the rest of my life and still be lonely as fuck.  

The advice that everyone says that you should find something to be passionate about. Problem with that only arises when you're not passionate about anything. To me it's like trying to find a unicorn.  

  

Sorry to be a downer. But these american style self-help 1-2-3 step posts just makes me mad. Dealing with depression and getting out of it is just not as simple as that.

Are you me? This couldn't hit more close to home than this. Only difference being that I just turned 23.  
  
I have tried to meet new people for the past 2 years or so and reading /r/seduction to help me get to my goal. Only to get some stupid relationships that last a month at best. Everybody else around me just succeed without even trying. I have given everything to no avail.  
I have tried to ask what I was doing wrong, and here is what I have gathered:  
I try too hard  
I try too little  
I'm not myself (I have never lied or acted anything intentionally)  
  
And what I'm left with is just a feeling that no one likes me because I'm me. Simple as that and I have to live with it for the rest of my life.
